# Sandstorm parser attribution

The sources under `src/client/java/de/tomalbrc/sandstorm/component`,
`curve`, `io`, and the selected utility classes are derived from
tomalbrc/Sandstorm tag `0.2-beta.1+1.21`.

- Upstream: https://github.com/tomalbrc/Sandstorm
- License: GNU Lesser General Public License v3.0 or later
- Included scope: Bedrock particle JSON component model, deserializers,
  curves, color helpers, and emitter direction definitions
- Excluded scope: Polymer, commands, server virtual entities, generated
  resource packs, and the upstream rendering backend

The Destiny client particle simulation and renderer are original integration
code. The complete upstream license is preserved in `LICENSE.txt`.
